title: chamaemelum fuscatum
intro: Chamaemelum fuscatum, commonly known as Black Chamomile, is a plant species in the sunflower family. It is known for its medicinal properties, which have been used to treat various health issues. The health benefits of Black Chamomile include its anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can aid in soothing digestive issues, reducing stress and anxiety, and promoting relaxation. The bioactive constituents of Black Chamomile include sesquiterpene lactones, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions such as sedation, anti-spasmodic effects, and immune system modulation.
